messages:
alice: Heads-up: We're planning a UPS switchover in az18 tonight 01:00-03:00 UTC. We'll do rolling rack reboots across 6 GPU racks to test failover. Expect ~15-30% capacity reduction in az18 during window. Please ack if any conflicting work.

ben: Ack. Can we route latency-sensitive traffic to eu-central and us-west2? :thumbsup:

alice: Yes — plan is smart-routing to eu-central for low-latency tenants and to us-west2 reserved pool for high-throughput. We'll enable fallback to dedicated-reserve-az18 (warm) for critical customers.

carla: Quick Q: how are we handling long-running KV caches? Need a KV seed before we open back up.

alice: Good catch. Pre-seeding plan: run cache-seed job after each rack reboot. Script: 
```
./ops/cache_seed.sh --pool gpu-az18-rack-$RACK --wait 120
```
I'll add to runbook.

james: On cost: routing to reserved pools overnight will add ~$1.9k for the window (est). Do we want to billback or absorb?

sophia: Let's absorb for now — this is a reliability test and affects multiple tenants. Finance signoff already on similar tests last quarter.

deploy-bot: Deploy freeze enabled: 2024-04-12T00:30Z -> 2024-04-12T04:00Z. Any active deploys will be blocked.

oncall-sre: Reminder: oncall during window is carla and james. We'll do 30m canary after first rack and hold for 15m.

carla: I'll handle canary observability. Will run kv/latency checks and post graphs. Need someone to watch tail on scheduler logs.

ben: I'll watch scheduler logs. Command:
```
kubectl logs -n infra scheduler-ops -f --tail=200
```

alice: Rollout order: racks 3->1->5->2->4->6 to respect cooling. Each rack cordon/drain, reboot, uncordon. Drains will use safe-evict policy: 
```
ops drain --rack R --mode=graceful --timeout=900
```
Estimated per-rack downtime ~12-18m including reboot+seed.

sophia: Do we need to notify customers in EU/US? Which customers hit az18 heavily?

alice: Notifying customers in az18 with reserved capacity only. I'll send comms to affected tenants list and post a platform-status scheduled maintenance link.

james: Also check cyclical autoscaler won't overprovision in us-west2 and blow budget. Set max surge to 1.5x.

carla: Acknowledged. I'll set autoscaler cap to x1.5 for the night.

alice: Final checklist added to runbook: /runbooks/az18-ups-switchover.md. I'll pin it here when done.

ben: :thumbsup:

alice: OK schedule: start 2024-04-12 01:00 UTC. If no objections by 22:00UTC today, we proceed. Leaving for final ack.

sophia: Ack

james: Ack

carla: Ack

deploy-bot: Deploy freeze lifted at 2024-04-12T04:00Z (scheduled).
